# ============================================================

test_meta <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    sequence_num = first(sequence_num),
    project_name = first(project_name),
    test_name    = first(test_name),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

current_run <- test_meta %>%
  filter(sequence_num == max(sequence_num))

baseline_run <- test_meta %>%
  filter(sequence_num == min(sequence_num))

current_run_id  <- current_run$run_id[1]
baseline_run_id <- baseline_run$run_id[1]

project_name  <- current_run$project_name[1]
scenario_name <- current_run$test_name[1]

applications <- raw_data %>%
  filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
  distinct(app_name) %>%
  arrange(app_name) %>%
  pull(app_name)

application_list <- paste(
  applications,
  collapse = ", "
)

error_summary <- raw_data %>%
  filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    is_pass = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in%
      c("true", "yes", "1")
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    app_name,
    label
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    total_transactions = n(),
    errors = sum(!is_pass, na.rm = TRUE),
    error_rate = round(
      errors / total_transactions * 100,
      2
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(errors > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(errors))

# ============================================================
# BASIC SLA STATUS + ACTUAL VS TARGET
# ============================================================

current_key <- as.character(current_run_id)

vu_status <- "N/A"
tp_status <- "N/A"
er_status <- "N/A"

vu_actual <- "-"
vu_target <- "-"

tp_actual <- "-"
tp_target <- "-"

er_actual <- "-"
er_target <- "-"

if (!is.null(sla_results[[current_key]])) {

  run_rules <- sla_results[[current_key]]$rules

  get_rule <- function(metric_name) {

    rule <- Filter(
      function(x) identical(x$metric, metric_name),
      run_rules
    )

    if (length(rule) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    rule[[1]]
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Virtual Users
  # ============================================================

  vu_rule <- get_rule("total_users")

  if (!is.null(vu_rule)) {

    vu_status <- ifelse(
      isTRUE(vu_rule$passed),
      "PASS",
      "FAIL"
    )

    vu_actual <- format(
      round(vu_rule$actual, 0),
      big.mark = ","
    )

    vu_target <- paste0(
      vu_rule$operator,
      " ",
      vu_rule$threshold
    )
  }
}

rt_summary <- get_run_rt_sla(current_run_id)

scenario_sla_summary <- NULL

scenario_total  <- 0
scenario_failed <- 0

if (!is.null(rt_summary)) {

  scenario_sla_summary <- rt_summary$all_labels %>%
    left_join(
      raw_data %>%
        filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
        distinct(label, thread_group),
      by = "label"
    ) %>%
    group_by(thread_group) %>%
    summarise(
      passed = all(passed),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  scenario_passed <- sum(
    scenario_sla_summary$passed,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  scenario_total <- nrow(
    scenario_sla_summary
  )

  scenario_failed <- scenario_total - scenario_passed

  rt_status <- if (
    scenario_failed == 0
  ) {
    "PASS"
  } else {
    "FAIL"
  }
}

tp_scenario_summary <- raw_data %>%
  filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    is_pass = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in%
      c("true", "yes", "1")
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    app_name,
    thread_group
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    successful_transactions = sum(is_pass),

    duration_secs = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        max(timestamp),
        min(timestamp),
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),

    throughput = ifelse(
      duration_secs > 0,
      round(
        successful_transactions /
        duration_secs,
        2
      ),
      0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(

    # Uses app-specific TPS threshold if configured.
    # Falls back to global threshold otherwise.
    target = get_app_tps_threshold(app_name),

    passed = throughput >= target

  ) %>%
  ungroup()

tp_scenario_passed <- sum(
  tp_scenario_summary$passed,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

tp_scenario_total <- nrow(
  tp_scenario_summary
)

failed_tp_scenarios <- tp_scenario_summary %>%

    transactions = n(),

      !is_pass,

    error_rate = round(

failed_er_scenarios <- er_scenario_summary %>%

status_class <- function(x) {

  if (x == "PASS") {
    return("status-pass")
  }

  if (x == "FAIL") {
    return("status-fail")
  }

  "status-na"
}

status_colour <- function(status) {

  if (status == "PASS") {
    return("#28a745")
  }

  if (status == "FAIL") {
    return("#dc3545")
  }

  "#6c757d"
}

delta_label <- function(
  current,
  baseline,
  lower_is_better = FALSE
) {

  if (is.na(current) || is.na(baseline)) {
    return("No Baseline")
  }

  if (baseline == 0) {

    if (current == 0) {
      return("▬ No Change from Baseline")
    }

    return("▲ New Metric vs Baseline")
  }

  delta <- round(
    ((current - baseline) / baseline) * 100,
    1
  )

  if (delta == 0) {
    return("▬ No Change from Baseline")
  }

  if (lower_is_better) {

    if (delta < 0) {

      return(
        sprintf(
          "▼ %.1f%% from Baseline",
          abs(delta)
        )
      )

    }

    return(
      sprintf(
        "▲ %.1f%% from Baseline",
        delta
      )
    )
  }

  if (delta > 0) {

    return(
      sprintf(
        "▲ %.1f%% from Baseline",
        delta
      )
    )

  }

  sprintf(
    "▼ %.1f%% from Baseline",
    abs(delta)
  )

}

  arrange(
    app_name,
    label,
    desc(error_count)
  )

build_error_tooltip <- function(df) {

  top_errors <- head(df, 3)

  additional_count <- max(
    nrow(df) - 3,
    0
  )

  tooltip <- paste(
    ifelse(
      top_errors$responseCode == "0" &
      top_errors$responseMessage == "0",

      sprintf(
        "No response code and error message (%s Errors)",
        top_errors$error_count
      ),

      sprintf(
        "HTTP %s - %s (%s Errors)",
        top_errors$responseCode,
        top_errors$responseMessage,
        top_errors$error_count
      )
    ),
    collapse = "\n\n"
  )

  if (additional_count > 0) {

    tooltip <- paste0(
      tooltip,
      "\n\n+",
      additional_count,
      " additional error types"
    )

  }

  tooltip

}

      <span style="width:24px;">🗀</span>
      <span style="width:100px;"><strong>Project:</strong></span>
      <span>%s</span>
    </div>

    <div style="display:flex; margin-top:6px;">

    </div>

    <div style="display:flex; margin-top:6px;">
      <span style="width:24px;">🖥</span>
      <span style="width:100px;"><strong>Applications:</strong></span>
      <span>%s</span>
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- Current Run -->
  <div style="
      flex:1;
      background:#f8f9fa;
      border:1px solid #dee2e6;
      border-radius:4px;
      padding:14px 16px;
  ">
    <div style="
      font-size:13px;
      color:#6c757d;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      font-weight:600;
      margin-bottom:8px;
    ">
      Current Run
    </div>

    <div><strong>%s</strong></div>

    <div style="margin-top:8px; display:flex;">
    <span style="width:80px; color:#6c757d;">⏱ Duration</span>
    <span>%s</span>
    </div>

    <div style="margin-top:4px; display:flex;">
    <span style="width:80px; color:#6c757d;">▷ Started</span>
    <span>%s</span>
    </div>

    <div style="margin-top:4px; display:flex;">
    <span style="width:80px; color:#6c757d;">▢ Ended</span>
    <span>%s</span>
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- Baseline Run -->
  <div style="
      flex:1;
      background:#f8f9fa;
      border:1px solid #dee2e6;
      border-radius:4px;
      padding:14px 16px;
  ">
    <div style="
      font-size:13px;
      color:#6c757d;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      font-weight:600;
      margin-bottom:8px;
    ">
      Baseline Run
    </div>

    <div><strong>%s</strong></div>

    <div style="margin-top:8px; display:flex;">
    <span style="width:80px; color:#6c757d;">⏱ Duration</span>
    <span>%s</span>
    </div>

    <div style="margin-top:4px; display:flex;">
    <span style="width:80px; color:#6c757d;">▷ Started</span>
    <span>%s</span>
    </div>

    <div style="margin-top:4px; display:flex;">
    <span style="width:80px; color:#6c757d;">▢ Ended</span>
    <span>%s</span>
    </div>

  </div>

</div>
',
project_name,
scenario_name,
application_list,
current_run_id,
current_duration,
current_start_fmt,
current_end_fmt,
baseline_run_id,
baseline_duration,
baseline_start_fmt,
baseline_end_fmt
)
